items.title: Willis appoints Chris Mulligan as Global Head of Risk Engineering
items.summary: Willis has named Chris Mulligan to lead its global network of risk engineers, effective January 1, 2027.

items.title: Aviva reports shrinking UK commercial book alongside improved operating ratio
items.summary: Aviva's UK commercial gross written premium fell by 5% in the first nine months of 2026 as the insurer maintained underwriting discipline in a softening market.

items.title: Chris Giles, PIB co-founder and broking consolidator, dies at 62
items.summary: The former Giles Insurance CEO, who shaped UK regional broking and co-founded PIB Group, has passed away at the age of 62.

items.title: IUAI launches Reinsurance and Data Study Group to expand technical focus
items.summary: The International Union of Aerospace Insurers has established its seventh study group to combine aviation data with practical reinsurance insights for global members.

items.title: London insurance brokers back AI adoption amid workforce and recruitment pressures
items.summary: Research by Burns & Wilcox Global Solutions shows widespread support for artificial intelligence among London brokers alongside concerns over replacement hiring and image challenges.

items.title: Microsoft outage prompts UK warnings over fraud and cyber policy gaps
items.summary: As Microsoft works to restore its cloud services following a global failure, financial institutions and brokers are warning clients about impersonation scams and coverage limits.
